reasoning: This is the classic RSS web feed syndication symbol (a bottom-left dot with two quarter-circle radiating arcs), which many everyday users also read as a Wi-Fi or generic wireless signal icon. It fits tasks centered on managing RSS/Atom feeds, blog syndication, podcast feeds, and wireless connectivity, though it can be confused with upright Wi-Fi or contactless NFC wave icons.
